note: Daniel Boone NF campground in the quiet Clear Creek Recreation Area south of Salt Lick. It has tent or RV pads in a wooded hollow, a boat ramp onto small Clear Creek Lake, and a picnic area with the ruins of an 1800s iron furnace. Sheltowee Trace and Clear Creek Lake trails start here. --Claude
